description.value: Peaked Pies is a family-run Australian bakery cafe operating in Whistler since 2013, serving handmade savoury meat pies, sweet pies, breakfast pies, and artisan coffee. Their signature 'peaked' preparation tops a pie with mashed potatoes, mushy peas, and gravy — a hearty, filling option for cyclists fuelling up. Rated #3 of 134 restaurants in Whistler on Google, it is tucked into the village on Main Street and draws a loyal local and visitor following.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the Whistler location at 105–4369 Main Street with phone 604.962.4115, matching OSM exactly. The menu page states 'traditional meat and veggie options available' and a blog post is titled 'Calling All Vegans…', confirming vegetarian/vegan offerings. The delivery page confirms food is available to-go via Uber Eats and Doordash; no evidence found for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: Blog content is dated 2019; website has not been substantially updated in several years, though the business appears actively operating across multiple locations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, highly-rated food stop in Whistler village with hearty hot food, coffee, and takeout options — a clear benefit to touring cyclists passing through.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page states 'traditional meat and veggie options available'; blog post titled 'Calling All Vegans…' (July 2019) indicates vegan options exist. No GF evidence found
